verdict.rationale: ZCode's docs say the bundled GLM-5.3-Flash model handles multimodal tasks such as screenshot understanding and image analysis out of the box. Combined with its agentic coding workbench, that suggests a user could feed in an image of a design, but no evidence shows the product turning a design into a working app. The Excalidraw example concerns plugin development and canvas collaboration, not sketch-to-app generation. Missing for 10: any documented design-to-app workflow, PDF design input support, sketch-specific handling, and hands-on evidence that a working app is produced from an image.
